preamble: The voiced palatal approximant /j/ developing into the voiceless alveolar plosive /t/ is a rare fortition combining occlusion, devoicing and fronting of place. It is attested in Awetí, where Proto-Tupian initial *j- corresponds to t-.
sources: Carling, G. (ed.) (2017). Diachronic Atlas of Comparative Linguistics (DiACL). https://diacl.ht.lu.se/
